function.description: Logs a food item with details about the portion size and the meal it is associated with. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

food_name.description: The name of the food to log.

portion_amount.description: The amount of the food item that was consumed, in specified units. This is a float type value.

portion_unit.description: The unit of measure for the portion amount. Choose a unit such as 'grams', 'ounces', 'pieces', 'cups', or 'tablespoons'.

meal_name.description: The name of the meal with which the food item is associated. Options include 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', or 'snack'.

message.content: Pizza is a dish that originated in Italy, specifically in the Naples region. The modern pizza we know today—flatbread topped with tomato sauce, cheese, and various toppings—evolved from earlier flatbreads that were eaten by the poor in Naples in the 18th and early 19th centuries. The classic “Margherita” pizza, topped with tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil to represent the colors of the Italian flag, was created in 1889 to honor Queen Margherita of Savoy. From Naples, pizza spread throughout Italy and eventually around the world, adapting to local tastes and ingredients along the way.
